chunks.text: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme providing 6000 rupees per year to eligible land-holding farmer families in three equal installments of 2000 rupees each.
The official PM-KISAN site shows the 22nd installment was released on 13 March 2026 and that eKYC is mandatory for registered farmers.
Farmers can check KYS or beneficiary status on the PM-KISAN portal. The site highlights exclusion cases such as some land owners after 01-02-2019 and multiple family members receiving the benefit.
